description: Delete a tax rate by id (GUID) or exact name, as the Settings page does (a soft delete). The default rate and the tenant's last rate cannot be deleted: make another rate the default first with save_tax_rate. The preview counts the items, item groups and customers or vendors that still use the rate; they keep it, so move them first if they should land elsewhere. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

taxRate.description: The tax rate to delete: its id (GUID) or its exact name.

name: delete_tax_rate
title: Delete Tax Rate
